service.title: Service
service.description: How the agent answers on this connection's inboxes. An inbox may have its own adjustment.

hints.grouping_seconds: Messages the contact sends in a row get one answer. From 0 to 30.
hints.max_messages: Longer answers are joined in the last message. From 1 to 5.
hints.max_chars: Guidance to the agent for short texts. From 100 to 1,000.
hints.interval_ms: Pause between the messages of one answer. Up to 5,000.

service.backToBot: After a handoff, the conversation returns to the agent when the team sets it back to "pending" in Chatwoot.
service.reset: The inbox uses the default again.
